known_limitations: Pixel-space predictions only: Outputs are 2D image-pixel coordinates [X, Y], NOT geographic coordinates (lat/long or UTM) and NOT cadastral parcel boundaries.
No height/elevation estimation: The model operates exclusively on 2D RGB imagery and does not predict 3D roof pitch, building height, or volume.
No legal/cadastral semantics: Does not assign official ULPIN identifiers, ownership, or land-use classification.

Seamless compound roofs: Visually continuous compound roofs with shared planar tin/concrete sheets lack RGB boundary contrast and cannot be reliably partitioned without elevation/DSM or cadastral vector data.

Dense cluster resolution: While YOLO11s-seg achieves 4.5x higher recall in dense clusters than the nano baseline, small buildings (<500 px^2) in high-density settlements may experience anchorless suppression.
